title: machine.toml
description:
This machine's name and icon, as every window shows it beside its
Projects and Threads, whether Banda starts at login here, and when it
stays awake. Each key is optional: Banda finds what is left out.

name.description:
Its name, up to 16 characters. Left out or empty: its hostname, or
a word for a hostname the system made up.

icon.description:
Its icon. Left out: what Banda finds the machine is, as a laptop by
its battery.

start-at-login.description:
Start Banda at login: its engine starts as you log in, so its
Agents and other machines find it running; on Linux with linger on,
as the machine starts. Off, it starts as you open Banda. On by
default; macOS and Linux have it so far.

awake-while-working.description:
Stay awake while Agents work: this machine does not idle-sleep
while a Turn runs here, and for 10 minutes after, so a message
from another machine finds it awake. Its display still sleeps, and
closing a MacBook's lid still sleeps it. On by default; macOS and
Linux have it so far.

awake-plugged-in.description:
Stay awake while plugged in: on power, this machine does not
idle-sleep, Agents or none, so other machines reach it. One with
no battery is always on power. Off by default.

updates.description:
Take Banda's updates: when-idle takes each new engine and restarts
on it once no Agent works here, no terminal is open and no key
reached one for ten minutes; ask takes it and waits for you to
restart; off takes none. when-idle by default.

MachineIcon.description:
The icons a host may take, each one of Lucide's, drawn in the text's
colour (ADR 0095, decision 1). None of them is drawn like an account's
emblem (ADR 0093), and no colour sets one machine apart: colour is the
account's.

oneOf.description: A desktop, a Mac mini, an iMac: `monitor`.

TakeUpdates.description:
Whether this machine takes Banda's updates by itself (ADR 0119,
decision 3).

oneOf.description: Takes each new engine, and restarts on it once nothing runs.
Takes each new engine, and waits for the Person to restart.
